subject.title: feat(agents): show searchable tool capabilities automatically

question: Should enabled Tool Search automatically spend part of every existing agent prompt on the bounded capability directory, rather than leaving capability discovery implicit?
rationale: This is a deliberate new default for existing configured users and changes agent context allocation and model guidance; tests can verify mechanics but cannot select the product default.

options.title: Confirm the automatic default
options.body: Accept the bounded directory as the standard Tool Search experience after reviewing its context-budget and model-behavior tradeoff.

options.title: Require explicit enablement
options.body: Keep existing Tool Search prompts unchanged unless a separately designed, documented configuration or setup decision enables the directory.

recommendation.title: Confirm the automatic default
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded directory as the standard Tool Search experience after reviewing its context-budget and model-behavior tradeoff.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence connects steipete to the proposed Tool Search prompt behavior, though current-main ownership history should be checked by the reviewing maintainer.
